verdict.rationale: Only peripheral pieces are readable. The docs describe the local MCP server as "open-source", and the Python SDK (perplexity-py) has a public GitHub repository, though the evidence never names its license. Nothing shows the Sonar API service itself is open source. Missing for 10: source for the core Sonar API/models under an open license, an explicitly stated license (e.g. MIT/Apache) for the SDK and MCP server repositories, and independent confirmation of the licensing terms.
